note: 삼국지 설계표(2026-11-02) — 장수 한 명이 여성 한 명. 세계 셋(삼국시대풍 · 서양 중세 판타지풍 · 메카풍)마다 다른 사람으로 그린다(사용자 2026-11-02 「삼국시대풍, 서양 중세 판타지 시대풍, 메카풍으로 나눠서 이것도 여성의인화」). 장수 목록·세력·역할·능력치·일화·낙관은 게임(index.html)의 표에서 tools/sam-design.py seed 가 받는다 — 게임은 그대로 둔다. 세력(factions)은 팔레트와 세계 글 · 장면 셋, 역할(roles)은 세계마다 차림과 일상컷에서 드는 기본 물건, 장수(generals)는 손 설계(designed: hand — title · traits · hold · look 을 직접)와 자동(designed: auto — 세력 팔레트 · 역할 · 열쇠로 돌린 look)으로 나뉜다. 고치면 python3 tools/sam-design.py check. 체형은 볼륨 · 굴곡이 있는 여덟 갈래만(사용자 2026-11-02 「체형을 전체적으로 볼륨감과 굴곡감이 느껴지게」 — hourglass · voluptuous · curvy · curvy_athletic · busty_slender · tall_curvy · strong_curvy · petite_curvy). 장신 · 건장 · 아담 · 마른 체형은 같은 결의 굴곡 체형으로 옮겼다. 메카 세계는 우주 · SF 배경(사용자 2026-11-02 「메카쪽은 배경을 좀 더 sf 쪽이나 우주쪽으로」).

vocab.look_note: 장수 look = 얼굴(face_shape · eyes · brows · nose · lips · eye_color + 얼굴 설계 age · impression · skin_tone · eye_size · eye_tilt · mark · expr) + 실루엣(body · hair · hair_color). 어휘는 lib/look-spec.js 와 lib/prompt-spec.js FACE_DESIGN. 색 · 체형 · 이목구비는 세 세계 공통, 헤어 · 앞머리 · 얼굴형 · 눈 모양은 look.worlds.<세계> 로 세계마다(세계마다 다른 사람 — 원소 공방 2026-10-30 과 같은 규칙). 머리 · 눈 색은 세력 팔레트에서.

factions.persona: 북방의 패권. 법과 질서, 강한 기병, 냉철한 실리. 검푸른 깃발.

palette.en: deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white

samguk.ko: 조위 — 허창 · 낙양 · 업, 북방 평원과 동작대
samguk.en: Cao Wei in northern China, around 200–235 AD: the walled capitals of Xuchang, Ye and Luoyang, rammed-earth ramparts and tiled watchtowers, black-and-navy banners over vast northern plains, armoured cavalry, bronze ritual vessels and lacquered halls

scenes.en: on the Bronze Sparrow Terrace at Ye, tiled roofs and a bronze sparrow ornament against the sky, the city below
inside a lacquered palace hall at Xuchang, red pillars, navy silk hangings and bronze braziers
a northern cavalry camp on the open plain, rows of navy banners, horses and campfires

fantasy.ko: 북방 제국 — 검은 돌 성채, 청색 깃발, 중기병, 눈 덮인 평원
fantasy.en: a stern northern empire of medieval high fantasy: black-stone citadels with blue banners, iron-shod heavy cavalry, snowy plains and pine forests, a court ruled by strict law, cold blue sigil-magic

scenes.en: a black-stone throne hall with tall blue banners and cold sigil-light
on a snow-covered castle rampart over a frozen plain, banners snapping in the wind
a mustering field of heavy cavalry knights in blue-black barding

mecha.ko: 2190 위 연방 — 궤도 요새, 기함 함대, 행성을 내려다보는 우주
mecha.en: year 2190, the Wei Federation in orbit: a navy-black orbital fortress and capital-ship fleet above a cold blue planet, starfields and a distant sun, hard white floodlights on armored hulls
mecha.design: navy-blue and black lacquer heavy plating with cold steel-silver edges, angular command fins, a disciplined symmetrical frame, cold blue glow lines

scenes.en: the command bridge of a navy-black capital ship, tactical holograms and the curve of a planet beyond the viewport
an orbital hangar bay open to space, frames racked behind her, stars and a blue planet below
on the outer gantry of an orbital fortress, a fleet of capital ships drifting against the starfield

factions.persona: 의리와 인덕. 험한 산과 안개 속의 나라, 한 황실의 정통을 잇는다는 뜻. 초록과 금빛.

palette.en: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade

samguk.ko: 촉한 — 성도 · 익주 분지, 잔도와 안개 낀 산, 도원
samguk.en: Shu Han in the Sichuan basin, around 208–263 AD: the city of Chengdu, cliffside plank roads over gorges, mist-wrapped mountains and bamboo forests, peach orchards, green-and-gold banners

scenes.en: in a peach orchard in full blossom, petals drifting, a stone table and wine cups
on a wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff, mist and a river gorge far below
a palace courtyard in Chengdu, green-tiled roofs, gold banners and bamboo

fantasy.ko: 옥빛 고원 왕국 — 초록 산등성이의 회색 돌 성 · 수도원, 알프스풍 초원 · 폭포 · 참나무 숲, 용 문장 깃발
fantasy.en: a righteous highland kingdom of Western medieval high fantasy: grey-stone castles and fortified abbeys on green mountain ridges, alpine meadows, waterfalls and oak forests, heraldic banners of green and gold bearing a dragon device, oaths sworn under an ancient oak, gentle green nature-magic

scenes.en: beneath a vast ancient oak where oaths are sworn, glowing green motes in the air, a stone castle on the ridge behind
on the stone bridge of a cliffside castle, waterfalls and green alpine peaks behind
at a fortified mountain-pass gatehouse of grey stone, green-and-gold heraldic banners

mecha.ko: 2190 촉 개척 위성 — 옥빛 위성의 돔 도시, 고리 행성, 궤도 엘리베이터
mecha.en: year 2190, the Shu frontier colony on a jade-green moon: terraced garden cities under vast glass domes, a ringed gas giant filling the sky, an orbital elevator climbing into space, starship docks glowing green
mecha.design: jade-green and white plating with imperial-gold trims, organic layered armor like overlapping leaves, a resilient all-terrain frame, warm green glow lines

scenes.en: inside a vast glass dome over terraced gardens, a ringed gas giant hanging in the sky above
on the platform of an orbital elevator high above the jade-green moon, stars all around
a starship dock with green work lights, a frigate under repair and open space beyond

factions.persona: 장강의 나라. 수군과 불, 젊은 영웅들, 남방의 풍요. 붉은 돛.

palette.en: crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer

samguk.ko: 동오 — 건업, 장강의 수군, 적벽의 불배, 남방의 비
samguk.en: Eastern Wu along the Yangtze, around 200–280 AD: the river capital Jianye, great war junks with crimson sails, river fortresses, southern rain and lotus marshes, the fire ships of the Red Cliffs

scenes.en: on the river at the Red Cliffs at night, fire ships blazing across the water, crimson sails and smoke
on the deck of a great crimson-sailed war junk on the wide Yangtze
a riverside palace pavilion at Jianye, lotus pond and red lacquer railings in soft rain

fantasy.ko: 붉은 돛의 강 왕국 — 대하, 갤리온 함대, 항구 요새, 물 위의 불 마법
fantasy.en: a river-and-sea kingdom of medieval high fantasy: a vast river delta, crimson-sailed galleons and war galleys, harbor fortresses of red stone, fire magic dancing over dark water

scenes.en: a red-stone harbor fortress with crimson-sailed galleons at anchor
at the prow of a war galleon cutting through waves, spray and fire-lit clouds
on a riverbank as fire magic sweeps across the water at night

mecha.ko: 2190 오 항모 함대 — 바다 행성 궤도, 붉은 우주선, 성운
mecha.en: year 2190, the Wu carrier fleet in orbit above an ocean world: crimson starships and carriers, a glowing nebula, the planet's blue oceans and storm clouds below, neon running lights on the hulls
mecha.design: crimson and black lacquer plating with gold edges, streamlined naval hull shapes and fin binders, hydrojet thrusters, flame-orange glow lines

scenes.en: the open flight deck of a space carrier, crimson fighters launching toward a nebula
an orbital shipyard where a crimson cruiser is being built, welding sparks against the stars
an observation deck above the ocean world, its storms and seas glowing below

factions.persona: 한 말의 난세. 황건, 동탁, 원소와 여포, 남만과 방사들 — 주인 없는 천하를 다투는 이들. 자줏빛과 금빛.

palette.en: royal violet, tarnished gold, bronze, dark crimson

samguk.ko: 후한 말의 난세 — 불타는 낙양, 호뢰관, 황건의 들판, 변방과 남만
samguk.en: the chaos of the late Eastern Han, around 184–200 AD: burning Luoyang, the Hulao Pass, Yellow Turban fields, warlord camps of rival banners, frontier steppe and the southern jungles of the Nanman

scenes.en: before the burning palaces of Luoyang, embers drifting through the night
at the great gate of the Hulao Pass, rival banners massed below
a warlord camp on the frontier, tents and banners of violet and gold under a wide sky

fantasy.ko: 무너진 제국의 군웅 — 폐허가 된 황도, 용병 진영, 국경 요새, 무법의 땅
fantasy.en: the shattered realms of medieval high fantasy, an age of rival warlords after a fallen empire: a ruined imperial capital, mercenary camps, border keeps, outlaw marches and wild southern jungles, dark violet battle-magic

scenes.en: in the ruined throne room of a fallen imperial capital, broken pillars and violet light
on the walls of a border keep held by a warlord, storm clouds gathering
a mercenary camp of mismatched banners around a bonfire

mecha.ko: 2190 자유 구역 — 무법의 소행성대, 소행성 요새, 난파 우주선, 보라 성운
mecha.en: year 2190, the Free Zones — a lawless asteroid belt between the three powers: warlord fortresses carved into asteroids, wrecked starships drifting in the dark, a violet nebula, warning lights blinking
mecha.design: mismatched violet and tarnished-gold plating with bronze patches and battle scars, aggressive spiked silhouette, salvaged parts and warlord insignia shapes, violet glow lines

scenes.en: a warlord fortress carved into an asteroid, violet floodlights and drifting rocks
on the hull of a wrecked capital ship drifting in the asteroid belt, the violet nebula behind
a neon-lit black-market hangar inside an asteroid, ships docked overhead

camps.note: 동탁과 서량의 잔당 — 이각 · 곽사, 완성의 장제 일가
서주 · 연주 · 하내 · 유주 · 강동 · 교주의 군소 제후

samguk.en: Han-dynasty ruler's regalia — layered silk robes in her faction's colours with broad embroidered sleeves, a jade-and-gold guan headpiece or a mian crown with beaded strings, jade pendants at the sash, a ceremonial jian sword at the belt

fantasy.en: a medieval monarch's regalia — a crown or circlet, an ornate breastplate under a fur-trimmed royal mantle, heraldic embroidery in her faction's colours, a sword of state

mecha.en: a command-type mecha — crowned head unit with an antenna crest, cape-like binder wings, heavy chest plating with an emblem core, a flagship back unit

samguk.en: Three Kingdoms war general's armor — lamellar scale armor laced over a silk battle robe, beast-head shoulder guards, a plumed helmet or a war headband, a long war cape, her weapon at hand

fantasy.en: a knight-champion's armor — articulated plate with a heraldic tabard in her faction's colours, a plumed helm or circlet, a battle cape, her weapon at hand

mecha.en: an assault-type mecha frame — heavy armor plates, thruster packs, reinforced limbs, her weapon rebuilt as a large mecha armament

hold.en: a bronze-hilted jian sword in its scabbard

samguk.en: a strategist's scholar robes — flowing layered silk robes with wide sleeves, a scholar's guan cap or silk ribbon, a feather fan or bound bamboo scrolls, a jade pendant

fantasy.en: an archmage-strategist's robes — layered robes with runic embroidery, a high collar, a circlet, a staff or a grimoire, star-chart motifs

mecha.en: a tactical electronic-warfare mecha frame — slender plating, a sensor-array head unit, holographic map projectors and floating drone bits

samguk.en: a Han court official's dress — layered robes with a broad belt and a hanging seal cord, a black jinxian guan cap, an ink brush and bound bamboo slips

fantasy.en: a royal chancellor's or court scholar's dress — a long embroidered coat with a stole, a seal ring, ledgers and a quill

mecha.en: a support and logistics mecha frame — lighter plating, data panels and shield units, utility sub-arms

hold.en: a bundle of bamboo slips tied with cord

summary.ko: 도원결의의 인덕 군주 — 쌍고검 · 어깨까지 닿는 옥 귀걸이(큰 귀) · 밤색 머리 · 처진 순한 눈 · 굴곡형

title.en: the benevolent founder of Shu Han, who swore sisterhood in the Peach Garden

traits.en: benevolence and humility that win hearts, humble straw-sandal beginnings under imperial Han blood, long jade earrings as her mark of fortune, the twin swords of the Peach Garden oath, tears shed for her people

hold.en: a pair of matched twin swords in one double scabbard

look.why: 인덕 — 둥근 눈썹 · 처진 순한 눈 · 따뜻한 베이지. 촉 팔레트의 흙빛 갈색이 머리, 금빛 호박색이 눈. 큰 귀 · 긴 팔은 그림에서 이상하게 나올 수 있어 어깨까지 닿는 옥 귀걸이로

generals.lore: 다섯 관문을 지나 여섯 장수를 베었다

summary.ko: 군신 — 청룡언월도 · 바닥까지 닿는 검은 포니테일(긴 수염) · 붉은 기 도는 구릿빛 피부 · 봉황 눈 · 초록 전포(삼국시대) · 장신 굴곡형

title.en: the God of War of Shu, loyal unto death, famed for her magnificent long 'beard'

traits.en: unbending loyalty and pride, a ruddy red-tinged complexion and long phoenix eyes, her legendary beard reimagined as an immensely long, sleek black ponytail, green and gold as her colours

hold.en: the Green Dragon Crescent Blade, a long guandao with a dragon-head guard

look.why: 긴 수염 → 바닥까지 닿는 매끈한 검은 머리(비단 주머니). 붉은 얼굴 → 붉은 기 도는 구릿빛 · 붉은 입술, 봉황 눈 → 치켜 올라간 긴 눈. 초록 전포는 촉 팔레트

traits.en: a green battle robe worn over her armor, a small bamboo-slip scroll of the Spring and Autumn Annals tied at her belt as an ornament (never held in her hands)

summary.ko: 장판교의 호랑이 — 장팔사모 · 사방으로 뻗친 검은 야생 머리(범 수염) · 날카롭게 올라간 눈매의 사나운 미인 · 자신만만한 미소 · 탄탄한 굴곡형

title.en: the thunder-voiced tiger general of Shu who held Changban Bridge alone

traits.en: a thunderous roar that turned an army back at Changban Bridge, wild temper and fierce joy, a love of wine, a striking wild beauty whose tiger-whiskered fierceness is reimagined as wild bristling hair and tiger-stripe trim

hold.en: the Serpent Spear, a long zhangba spear with a wavy serpent-shaped blade

look.why: 사용자 2026-11-03 「조금은 더 미형으로 … 지금은 너무 돼지같은 인상」 — 눈을 질끈 감고 입을 크게 벌린 웃음(laughing) · 둥근 얼굴 · 뭉툭한 코 · 발그레한 볼 · 낮고 짙은 눈썹 · 크고 둥근 눈이 겹친 탓. 사나운 인상 · 뻗친 검은 머리 · 호박색 눈 · 장팔사모는 그대로 두고, 날렵한 눈썹 · 올라간 눈매 · 곧은 코 · 도톰한 하트 입술 · 스모키 눈매 · 자신만만한 미소(proud)로

history.summary: 장판교의 호랑이 — 장팔사모 · 사방으로 뻗친 검은 머리(범 수염) · 크게 웃는 입 · 발그레한 볼(술) · 탄탄한 굴곡형
history.why_replaced: 사용자 2026-11-03 「외모가 성격에는 맞는 외모 같긴한데, 조금은 더 미형으로 갔으면 하거든. 지금은 너무 돼지같은? 그런 인상」

look.why: 호랑이 수염 · 우레 같은 목소리 → 사방으로 뻗친 숱 많은 검은 머리 · 크게 웃는 입 · 짙은 눈썹. 술 → 발그레한 볼

traits.en: a thunderous roar that turned an army back at Changban Bridge, wild temper and fierce joy, a love of wine, a tiger-whiskered fierceness reimagined as wild bristling hair and tiger-stripe trim

generals.lore: 품에 아두를 안고 백만 진중을 돌파했다

summary.ko: 상산의 용 — 은빛 용 장식 창 · 은백 머리 · 은빛 갑옷 흰 깃 · 차가운 인상 · 탄탄한 굴곡형

title.en: the dragon of Changshan, who carried the infant heir through the enemy host at Changban

traits.en: calm, flawless courage, gleaming silver armor with white plumes, cutting through a hundred thousand enemies at Changban to save the infant heir, a body made all of courage, quiet modesty

look.why: 은빛 갑옷 · 백마 → 은백 머리. 침착한 용기 → 차가운 인상 · 곧은 눈썹. 촉 팔레트 옥빛이 눈

generals.lore: 서량의 비단 갑옷, 조조가 수염을 잘랐다

summary.ko: 금마초 — 백은 용두 창 · 비단 두른 은갑 · 흰 깃 · 고금빛 머리 · 얼음빛 눈 · 붉은 입술 · 화려한 · 탄탄한 굴곡형

title.en: the splendid Ma Chao of Xiliang, the brocade-armored warrior who once sent Cao Cao fleeing

traits.en: dazzling beauty and pride of the western frontier, silver armor trimmed with brocade and a lion-head belt, a white plume, vengeance for her slain family, fierce charges across the Liang steppe

hold.en: a silver dragon-tipped spear with a white tassel

look.why: 시안(claude 2026-11-02) — 게임 일화 「서량의 비단 갑옷, 조조가 수염을 잘랐다」 와 역사 속 성정에서 이름 설명 · 물건 · 인상 · 표정을 잡고, 머리 · 눈 색은 촉 팔레트 안에서 다른 장수와 겹치지 않게. 헤어 · 얼굴형 · 눈 모양(세계마다)은 자동 돌림 그대로.

summary.ko: 노익장 궁신 — 큰 활 · 붉은 깃 화살 · 잿빛 섞인 머리 · 30대 초반 · 그을린 피부 · 우쭐한 · 건장한 굴곡형

title.en: the veteran archer of Shu who outshone the young at Dingjun Mountain

traits.en: a seasoned veteran whose aim never fails, silver-streaked hair worn proudly, a heavy saber at her hip, the victory at Dingjun Mountain

hold.en: a great recurved war bow with a quiver of red-fletched arrows

look.why: 시안(claude 2026-11-02) — 게임 일화 「노년에 정군산에서 하후연을 베었다」 와 역사 속 성정에서 이름 설명 · 물건 · 인상 · 표정을 잡고, 머리 · 눈 색은 촉 팔레트 안에서 다른 장수와 겹치지 않게. 헤어 · 얼굴형 · 눈 모양(세계마다)은 자동 돌림 그대로.
look.spread: 2026-11-03 외형 다시 나누기 — 많이 쓴 값 · 겹치는 조합을 덜 쓴 값으로(사용자 「외형 관련 분류가 부족하면 더 추가 … 겹치는게 있을 수 밖에」)

summary.ko: 와룡 — 백우선 · 먹빛 녹음 긴 머리 · 금빛 눈(별을 읽는다) · 학창의(삼국시대) · 팔괘진 · 가늘고 풍만한 형

title.en: the Sleeping Dragon, chancellor and master strategist of Shu

traits.en: a white crane-feather fan, serene foresight, the Eight Trigrams battle formation, borrowing the east wind and arrows with straw boats, wooden oxen and gliding horses, reading the stars

look.why: 와룡 — 먹빛에 녹음이 도는 긴 머리, 금빛 눈(별을 읽는다). 백우선 · 학창의는 성정 줄과 일상컷 소품

traits.en: white Daoist robes with a crane-feather cloak

summary.ko: 봉추 — 봉황 깃 부채 · 헝클어진 적갈색 머리 · 주근깨 · 장난스러운 · 대충 걸친 도포 · 골반 굴곡형
